standards.name: UK Cross-Government Metadata Exchange Model (xGov MEM)
standards.purpose: A common model for describing datasets, data services and distributions so catalogues across government can exchange metadata.
standards.status: Endorsed for implementation by the Data Standards Authority Steering Board
standards.evidence: Model content verified: vendored from co-cddo/ukgov-metadata-exchange-model at commit d6d9a24. Endorsement wording is from the published model page as recorded by the owner; page not re-read this session. Not listed in the DSA Standards Catalogue page as read on 8 November 2026.

standards.name: Data Catalog Vocabulary (DCAT)
standards.purpose: W3C vocabulary for describing datasets and data services in catalogues; the base vocabulary xGov MEM builds on.
standards.evidence: xGov MEM classes map to dcat:Dataset, dcat:DataService and dcat:Distribution (read from the vendored model)

standards.name: Algorithmic Transparency Reporting Standard (ATRS)
standards.purpose: A standard way for public sector bodies to publish information about the algorithmic tools they use.
standards.evidence: Read at the DSA Standards Catalogue page (published 28 July 2023, updated 25 October 2023) on 8 November 2026: listed as Endorsed, OGL. The catalogue names it the Reporting Standard; GOV.UK pages also use Recording Standard.

standards.name: Beneficial Ownership Data Standard (BODS) v0.2
standards.purpose: Collect, use, exchange and publish information about who owns and controls companies and other legal entities.
standards.evidence: Read at the DSA Standards Catalogue page (published 28 July 2023, updated 25 October 2023) on 8 November 2026: listed as Endorsed, Apache 2.0, entry updated 16 March 2022. The entry heading says v0.3 but its text says to use v0.2; check the Open Ownership site for the current version.

standards.name: Common Format and MIME Type for Comma-Separated Values (CSV) Files (RFC 4180)
standards.purpose: The common format for publishing tabular data as CSV.
standards.evidence: Read at the DSA Standards Catalogue page (published 28 July 2023, updated 25 October 2023) on 8 November 2026: listed as Endorsed, entry updated 2 February 2021; the catalogue gives no licence.

standards.name: OpenAPI 3 (describing RESTful APIs)
standards.purpose: A machine-readable way to describe RESTful APIs.
standards.evidence: Read at the GOV.UK recommended open standards page (updated 28 September 2023) on 8 November 2026. Not in the DSA Standards Catalogue.

standards.name: Open Referral UK
standards.purpose: Describe local services (who provides what, where and when) so directories can share the information.
standards.evidence: Read at the DSA Standards Catalogue page (published 28 July 2023, updated 25 October 2023) on 8 November 2026: listed as Endorsed, CC BY-SA 4.0, entry updated 16 March 2021.
